requirements.must: Use real workspace destinations; hide inactive tasks from layout and accessibility; preserve Back and current location.
Show compact actual summaries, exceptions, phone list and contextual inspector; administrative forms belong elsewhere.
Keep Home, Activity and Setup visible; preserve advanced Connection and Tools without automatic actions.
Show one current setup task and one primary decision; ordinary Home fits portrait, enlarged content stays readable and scrollable.
Preserve keyboard, focus, announcements, reduced motion, non-color state and accessible target sizes at enlarged text.
Retain the canonical dark-green palette and consistent product terminology.
Select service independently before scan; reject a QR origin mismatch; never trust a returned arbitrary stream host.
Scan one bounded ticket and display exact comparison values; owner explicitly approves without retyping displayed values.
Carry approved device identity via distinct fresh existing-key proof; derive stream address from trusted service; revalidate current authority.
Select SIM explicitly and request each missing permission through its own purpose disclosure.
Start connection only explicitly; reboot resume is initially unchecked; pause retains local-receiving disclosure.
Generate line identifier, use actual selected phone/capability and retrieve declaration without duplicate unresolved requests.
Retain approval-key/MFA and exact line decision; changed SIM, key, generation or initiating session requires fresh affected review.
Resume from current authenticated facts with only public locators persisted; checkpoints never restore authority or secrets.
Reconcile uncertain mutations without repeating them or creating replacements; unavailable status leaves an explanation and help path.
Reject delayed results after screen/account/session/operation replacement, revocation or key/SIM invalidation.
Serve registration, verification, sign-in, required security and account recovery with open/invite/closed availability.
Show authoritative configured price, currency, recurrence, limits and payment terms; explain hardware/SIM/carrier requirements before purchase.
Use account-bound provider checkout/portal handoffs; verify current subscription state on return; pending status blocks duplicate purchase.
Keep disabled, TEST and LIVE namespaces/capabilities distinct; TEST never grants LIVE authority; live support needs executed acceptance.
Self-hosted setup works without Stripe customer, plan or hosted subscription.
Hosted pairing needs no second account registration, server-address typing, card form or purchase-leading link.
Connection, line approval, submission, delivery, content consent and dispatch readiness remain distinct; absent observations are unavailable.

recovery_scenarios.given: Page closed after confirmed phone approval
Verification email is missing or expired
Pairing QR expired; previous result not yet checked
New login during original-session-bound line ceremony
Checkout return arrived before authoritative confirmation
Provider confirmed previous payment was unsuccessful
App data cleared or existing device key is missing
Late success arrives after account or session replacement
